notes.title: The Age of Restraint DLC patch 2
notes.notes:
Hey, detectives!

We pushed another patch for The Age of Restraint DLC:

• Dance animation optimization
• Art and text updates for consistency and clarity

notes.title: The Age of Restraint DLC patch 1
notes.notes:
This patch introduces the following improvements for DLC 3:

Updated puzzle contents to allow some alternative correct solutions
Updated puzzle contents to eliminate some wrong inputs that were validated as true
Updated some art inconsistencies
 Improved some language layout issues

notes.title: Music system hotfix
notes.notes: We pushed a fix for an issue with overlapping music tracks, as well as an incorrect translation key in the "Newsflash" scenario.

notes.title: Steam Deck verification patch
notes.notes: We've pushed changes to comply with the Steam Deck verification guidelines, fix a regression that caused music not to play in some parts of certain scenarios, and fix some other minor content issues.

notes.title: Small wording and asset patch
notes.notes: We did some minor wording updates for the base game and updated some assets for The Lemurian Phoenix DLC.

notes.title: Patch 2 for The Lemurian Phoenix
notes.notes: We fixed multiple artwork issues in The Lemurian Phoenix reported by the community, as well as a bug that caused the ending intermission to play every time you exited the last scenario. For players who have already finished the DLC, it will play once more on exit, but shouldn't play after.

notes.title: Hotfix 1 for The Lemurian Phoenix
notes.notes: We fixed an issue reported by players where a couple of phrases in the 5th scenario of The Lemurian Phoenix DLC, "Blaze of Glory," weren't movable with a mouse.

notes.title: The release of the 2nd DLC "The Lemurian Phoenix"
notes.notes: Includes the content for the 2nd The Rise of the Golden Idol DLC, The Lemurian Phoenix, as well as a bunch of minor fixes, mostly for the Steam Deck.

notes.title: The Sins of New Wells hotfix 1
notes.notes:
In this patch we have addressed the following issues:

- Finishing the SIns of New Wells chapter puzzle now should give the achievement (revisiting it should trigger for those who missed it).

- Fixed the mixed name and surname slots in Unravelling recollection puzzle in most of the translations.

- Added Japanese community translators to credits.

- A number of minor content fixes.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0: Localization update and some quality-of-life improvements
notes.notes:
Dear detectives!

We have pushed out a new update, containing the following improvements:


Numerous text tweaks in all 12 languages, thanks to your feedback.

Option to move phrases by clicking instead of dragging.

Ability to zoom into text in close-ups (we introduced this in the previous patch, but forgot to document it!).

Better controller support. Now, the settings menu contains controls mapping information, and there are button prompts when the game detects a controller.

Fixed Z-ordering bug that sometimes made collected words visible through menus and puzzle panels.

Improved visibility of certain hotspot highlights.

Some puzzles now accept alternative words as correct, to reduce the number of cases in which the player has figured out the answer but is deemed ‘wrong’ for using the unintended word.

Basic mod support, which allows for easier extending of the game with features like fan translations.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.notes:
In this patch we have addressed the following issues:


 Removed white frame in full-screen mode.
 Achievements should re-trigger when you visit a scenario, if you did not receive the correct achievement after finishing a scenario.
 Removed ability to break the game on Steamdeck using full-screen toggle.
 Now there is a zoom functionality (accessible using mouse-wheel or button Y on a controller).
 Display settings are stored per device, instead on the cloud.
 External controller disconnection should not remove Steamdeck inputs anymore.
 A few minor typos fixed in the texts.

notes.title: Release timing, pricing, and the future of the Golden Idol series
notes.notes:
Hello Detectives,

We have some news to share ahead of the game’s launch next week regarding release timing, pricing, and future plans.

Release Timing
The Rise of the Golden Idol will be releasing worldwide on all platforms November 12, 2024 @10AM PST.

The Nintendo Switch release has been hit with an unexpected delay in a few territories and will now be releasing on November 14, 2024 @ 10AM PST.

Pricing & Looking Forward
The Rise of the Golden Idol will be launching at $19.99 or Steam's regional recommended equivalent. For the first week we will also be offering a 10% launch discount, so take advantage of that before it is gone.

Additionally - today we are announcing that we will be continuing to support The Rise of the Golden Idol throughout 2025 with new content. There are a ton of additional standalone stories we want to tell set in the Golden Idol universe, and we found that the best way to tell these stories is through four self-contained DLC chapters - called Investigations.

Similar to the DLC released for The Case of the Golden Idol, these are optional side content and are not required to conclude the story in The Rise of the Golden Idol. Rather, these are for fans who want more puzzles, more characters, and more mysteries to solve. Each of the four Investigations chapters will include at least four new cases to solve. On top of the base game’s 20 scenarios - that is a lot of sleuthing.

Our roadmap has a sneak peak at the first Investigations chapter and when you can expect all future content to drop.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781302/289379ee65a83e1a5be7b5332dca277155c63093.png

These will be available for sale individually as they release for $5.99 or as part of the Detective's Pass, a discounted pack of all four chapters and the complete soundtrack for $17.99. We will also be offering a permanent stacking discount for owners of The Case of the Golden Idol, so that you can pick up The Rise of the Golden Idol and all future content at an even cheaper price.

We can’t wait for you all to dive into the next installment of Golden Idol when it launches next week.

- Team Idol

notes.title: Release Date Reveal, Extended Demo, and Case Redux
notes.notes:
Hello Detectives,

We have lots of exciting news to share for new and returning fans of Golden Idol.

Release Date - November 12, 2024
The Rise of the Golden Idol will be launching on Steam, Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series, PlayStation 5, and Mobile approximately one month from now. Check out the new release date trailer for a sneak peek at what’s in store.

[previewyoutube=BlOOlkAc4N4;full][/previewyoutube]


Steam Next Fest Demo - Available now!

We have prepared an extended demo including all the content from the previous demo as well as an additional case for players to solve. While officially the demo is part of the upcoming Steam Next Fest, eager detectives can get their hands on it starting today.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2716400/The_Rise_of_the_Golden_Idol/


The Case of the Golden Idol Redux Update - Available now!

Last week we announced a new update coming to The Case of the Golden Idol - called Redux. Learn more about that announcement here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1677770/view/4677641741933164088

The update is available today for all current (and future) owners of The Case of the Golden Idol. You should be prompted to update the next time you launch the game, and choose either the classic or Redux version to launch. While this update features no new playable cases or scenarios, it introduces a number of new features that make it a smoother experience overall.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1677770/The_Case_of_the_Golden_Idol/

Here are some highlights from the Redux update.

12 supported languages:
English (US)
French
Italian 
German
Spanish (Latin America)
Spanish (Spain)
Portuguese (Brazil)
Japanese
Korean 
Polish
Turkish
Chinese (Traditional)

*Chinese (Simplified) will be made available at a later date. 

New UI & Hint System
Returning players should notice an overhaul to the UI, which should improve readability and navigation, especially at smaller resolutions. Additionally, there are now markers that indicate what objects can be interacted with, so no more guessing or using guides when you get stuck.


Steam Deck Support
Support for Steam Deck is now in beta. In addition to running smoother, the UI and text should now scale to appropriately fit the screen size. Once the review process completes, The Case of the Golden Idol will be listed as a Verified title on the store and in your library, a process we expect to take a few weeks.

For Nintendo Switch Owners - The new release of The Case of the Golden Idol: Complete Edition will need to be manually claimed on the Nintendo eShop, and is free for all current owners. This rerelease includes all of the above changes and addresses an infrequent issue that caused some players to lose all save progress.

And finally…
A thanks from Team Idol & Playstack for all the support for the Golden Idol over the past couple years. We hope you enjoy the demo and can’t wait for everyone to check out The Rise of the Golden Idol when it releases next month.

Wishlist, follow, tell a friend, etc.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2716400/The_Rise_of_the_Golden_Idol/

- Team Idol
